lines.text: THIS ANGEL ADMITS IT. SHE CALLED THE EXTERMINATION TO SILENCE THE SINNERS speaking out, EMPOWERING EACH OTHER. YOU DID IT TO KEEP US DOWN
lines.de: THIS ANGEL ADMITS IT. SHE CALLED THE EXTERMINATION TO SILENCE THE SINNERS speaking out, EMPOWERING EACH OTHER. YOU DID IT TO KEEP US DOWN

lines.text: WELL, we are not going [music] to be kept down anymore.

lines.text: Consider this a declaration of holy war.

lines.text: I've woken up the people to the lies you angels tell.

lines.text: When we pay you a visit, we won't be bringing baskets. will be bringing decimation that'll put you in caskets.
lines.de: When we pay you a visit, we won't be bringing baskets. will be bringing decimation that'll put you in caskets.

lines.text: I'll show you what it means to be the motherfucking king of hell.
lines.de: I'll show you what it means to be the motherfucking king of hell.

lines.text: Cuz I'm the furer. I'm immense. [music]
lines.de: Cuz I'm the furer. I'm immense. [music]

lines.text: I am the avatar of your contest.

lines.text: I'm your OMEGA. I'm the flood. [music]
lines.de: I'm your OMEGA. I'm the flood. [music]

lines.text: I am the nightmare you made when you spilled our blood
